findings.text: non-blocking: `_mark_generate_docs_exhausted` duplicates the capability owned by imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_claim_release.py:1230 `_mark_refine_docs_exhausted` — same MATCH, same SET of docs_stage='exhausted' with the claim cleared, differing only in the stage filter ('pending' vs 'refining') and the comment tag — rather than parameterising the owner's stage; the copy also drops the `edit_status` closing CASE that both existing exhaust paths (graph_claim_release.py:1190-1197 and :1250-1253) carry, so a docs steering edit open on a pending name is left open by the new path. The node was fenced out of the owner's file and records the durable home under outside_scope, so this is for a later node to fold.

non-blocking: the recorded negative control for the gap-1 test (negative-control-refusal-released.log) fails by pytest-timeout at the repo's 30 s default with no assertion message, so it does not demonstrate that `assert stage["docs_stage"] == "exhausted"` is what catches the regression; the passing arm is already near the limit (the sibling tests took 25.7 s and 38.1 s in the same run directory), so the red is indistinguishable from a slow harness. The assertion would in fact redden — with the repair removed the stage stays 'refining' through three iterations — but the evidence on file does not show it doing so.

non-blocking: the generate-path test patches `worker_generate_docs._mark_generate_docs_exhausted` with a MagicMock, so it proves only that the worker calls the marker and never that the marker moves the name; a wrong stage filter, a wrong claim token or a malformed reviewer comment in the new Cypher at worker_tasks/worker_generate_docs.py:696-713 leaves every test green.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a test that feeds the same contradicting answer on every attempt, reads the terminal state within the existing bound and the model calls it cost, shown failing; tests/standard_names/test_refine_docs_settled_wording.py:124-137 does all of that, but the recorded red (negative-control-refusal-released.log) is a pytest-timeout at 30 s rather than the assertion at :129, so "shown failing" is shown by a budget expiry and not by the guard speaking.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to close the four gaps an earlier review found in the rendered shared wording; all four are closed — the terminal state is reached on both writers (imas_codex/standard_names/worker_refine_docs.py:371-377, imas_codex/standard_names/worker_tasks/worker_generate_docs.py:1038-1057), gap 2 takes the brief's second branch with reasons (docs/evidence/fragments/sn-definitions-by-construction/sdbc-rendered-wording-repair.html:15-19), the description repair is read back from what was stored (tests/standard_names/test_refine_docs_settled_wording.py:141-187), and the unreachable disjunct is gone from imas_codex/standard_names/docs_gates.py:1144-1146.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 8346104bf, 199403fc1, 9542d488d, tests naming the five-file pytest gate, test_logs naming gate-settled-wording-repair.log (revision 199403fc1, EXIT=0, 107 passed) and four mutation logs, negative_control_log naming negative-control-refusal-released.log; it records no baseline_suite or after_suite pair, which its brief excused by stating that the section's two-arm control is not re-run here.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the fence was docs_gates.py, worker_generate_docs.py, worker_refine_docs.py, tests/test_generate_docs.py, tests/test_docs_gates.py, tests/test_refine_docs_settled_wording.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; git diff --stat 4cc49b7c0..9542d488d touches six of them — docs_gates.py, both worker modules, test_docs_gates.py, the new test file and the evidence fragment — every path inside the fence, with test_generate_docs.py and the figures directory declared but unused.

justifications.durability: the description and generate-terminal tests each redden on their own removed repair (negative-control-description-repair-removed.log, negative-control-generate-terminal.log), but the refine test reddens by timeout and the only new query, worker_tasks/worker_generate_docs.py:683, is replaced by a MagicMock at tests/standard_names/test_refine_docs_settled_wording.py:236 so no test fails if that Cypher is wrong.

justifications.fit: the additions follow their files' idiom — worker_tasks/worker_generate_docs.py already opens GraphClient directly at :789 and :808, and the new comments state the mechanism (worker_refine_docs.py:359-369) with no plan, ticket or attribution text.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all four gaps are closed in the landed diff, and imas_codex/standard_names/worker_refine_docs.py:371-377 reaches the pre-existing terminal marker rather than introducing a second counter, exactly as gap 1 asked.
justifications.reuse: worker_tasks/worker_generate_docs.py:683 re-implements the docs-exhausted transition that graph_claim_release.py:1230 already owns, copying its Cypher nearly verbatim and changing only the eligible stage and comment tag instead of extending the owner.
